title: Compute ΔF/F
description: ΔF/F of each ROI, by one of dev's methods. subtract: F is the signal less neuropilFactor times its neuropil signal, and ΔF/F = (F - F0) / F0. chen2013 (Chen et al. 2013): as subtract, with the neuropil's baseline added back to F. dffMinusNeuropil: the signal's ΔF/F less neuropilFactor times the neuropil's ΔF/F. A baseline (F0, N0) is a percentile over the whole trace or over a window of frames centred on each frame. A correction window then subtracts a running percentile of ΔF/F, to take out slow drift. Percentiles interpolate linearly between the sorted values, as NumPy's do.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: Variable that holds the signals (frames x ROIs).

neuropil.title: Neuropil signals
neuropil.description: Variable that holds the neuropil signals. Leave empty for none.

output.title: ΔF/F
output.description: Variable the result is saved to.

method.title: Method
method.description: subtract: (F - k·neuropil - F0) / F0. chen2013: the neuropil's baseline added back (Chen et al. 2013). dffMinusNeuropil: ΔF/F of the signal less k times the neuropil's ΔF/F.

baselineWindow.title: Baseline window (frames)
baselineWindow.description: 0 for one baseline over the whole trace

correctionWindow.title: Correction window (frames)
correctionWindow.description: 0 for none; else a running percentile of ΔF/F over this many frames is subtracted (dev's correctBaseline used 500).
